name: Chicken Shawarma Lettuce Wraps with Avocado & Lemon-Garlic Mayo

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ lemons
3 tomatoes
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine the spice rub.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
salt
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the spice rub.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken breast dry with paper towels and cut into thin strips. Add to the bowl and toss to combine.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions and chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 7-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic, then add mayo, oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice.
To serve, separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chicken, tomato, and avocado. Drizzle with lemon-garlic mayo and enjoy!
